Play Services, Play Store, firmware updates, HDMI, keyboard and remote services are protected. No app data is deleted. Backups stay privately on this TV; do not clear launcher data before restoring components.

This disables the stock home screen and its recommendations. First select this launcher as the system default and return here with the real Home button. Button interception alone is not enough. A private backup is saved before disabling. Use Restore here to undo.
Recommendation cards provided by this component will stop. This does not remove advertisements inside streaming apps. Save a backup and disable this component?
Restore the state recorded before freezing this component?
The operation could not finish. Nothing is retried automatically. For a stock launcher, first check the system default Home. Any saved recovery entry remains available.
